name: Delivery Driver Automatic Deactivation
description: On a fictional delivery app, an AI model combines customer ratings, delivery times, GPS traces and cancellation rates into a driver score and automatically and permanently deactivates the accounts of drivers who fall below the threshold, ending their income from the platform.
documentation:
DATA: driver name, Iqama/ID, nationality, GPS location every 10 seconds (including off-shift), customer ratings and comments, earnings.
DECISION: deactivation is automatic and permanent; drivers receive a generic message with no reason.
OVERSIGHT: no human review and no appeal channel.
BIAS: customer ratings are known to be lower for some nationalities; no fairness testing; traffic and restaurant delays are counted against drivers.
PRIVACY: GPS tracking continues outside working hours; no retention period.
LOGGING: the reasons for deactivation are not stored.
